## Notes

Tick 0.2 s; cell-to-cell q = dT x dt x k x 1000, x25 solid-gas, x625 liquid-liquid; no transfer below 1 C or 0.1 DTU; per-tick change capped at a quarter of the difference; insulated tile conductivity divided by (255/2)^2; building and pipe formulas.
